title: Showroom Experience and Sales Staff
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on showroom impressions and occasional staff interactions, with clear praise in some fragments but many examples that are too vague or context-limited to determine sentiment toward the topic itself.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise showrooms that are easy to browse and mention friendly, welcoming sales staff.

negative.summary: Negative feedback includes a strongly unfavorable showroom-related remark, but the sample does not provide specific operational issues behind it.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the showroom in passing or use vague wording, so they do not clearly express a sentiment about the showroom experience.

limitations: Several fragments are too brief or context-limited to identify a clear opinion about the showroom topic.
One positive fragment appears unrelated to the showroom theme and limits topic coherence.
The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews on this topic.
